featured_reviews.review_text:
I was refused disability assessment today , despite repeated requests, when I went in person( within 9am to 12pm assessment time). I was told by the person who checks forms that I should have taken prior appointment even though I had called one day before and was told appt not required. When I requested the doctor on duty and his asst they made me do about 3-4 movements against resistance and said I  would not get a disability certificate as I don't meet the criteria. They decided this without even doing a full assessment and despite me showing them notes from my orthopedics and physiotherapists over the years saying I have disability/describing my disabilities. I also showed them my 3D biometric assessment and surgery picture. They refused to give details of criteria under which they are rejecting me and said if you want still want assessment you will have to come again.

So not only they did not give me assessment but also told me even if I come again I won't meet their criteria. I called and emailed in advance, travelled 1.5hr each way and spent rs900+ for this (as I cannot travel in buses/trains due to my disability). Now I will again have to do the same and may possibly be rejected.

I feel not only is this harassment to the disabled but also being subjective about who gets the disability certificate as even the the final percentage is computer generated, the people who enter these can have biased view. Where I can complain about all this?
